problem_statement: Women face various health and wellness challenges throughout different stages of life, including menstrual health, pregnancy, postpartum care, nutrition, mental well-being, fitness, and menopause. Access to personalized and reliable health information can be limited.
solution: An AI-powered assistant that provides personalized wellness information, health tracking, reminders, and guidance while encouraging users to consult qualified healthcare professionals when necessary.
goal: To provide a safe, accessible, and personalized digital assistant for women's everyday health and wellness needs.
